name: azure-resources
title: Azure Resources
description: Browse Azure resource groups and resources and open them in the Azure Portal
author: eimerreis

commands.name: search-resource-groups
commands.title: Search Resource Groups
commands.description: Shows Azure resource groups in a searchable list

commands.name: open-azure-resource
commands.title: Open Azure Resource
commands.description: Opens an Azure Resource in Azure Portal

commands.name: switch-azure-subscription
commands.title: Switch Azure Subscription
commands.description: Switches the subscription used by this extension without changing the Azure CLI default

preferences.name: azCliPath
preferences.title: Azure CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the Azure CLI executable

preferences.name: showResourceDetailsInList
preferences.title: Show Resource Details in List
preferences.description: Show some resource details directly in the Resource List. Might lead to resource names not being fully visible.
preferences.label: Show Resource Details in List

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
